label: Bible Study
prompt: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by _____ alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
verse: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God.
note: Jesus answers the tempter by quoting Deuteronomy — after forty days of fasting, no less.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a _____ heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verse: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
note: God isn't nearest to the polished — He's nigh unto the broken-hearted, right where it hurts.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup _____ over.
verse: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies: thou anointest my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
note: Psalm 23's banquet scene: a table set in front of the enemies, and a cup that runneth over.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But we have this treasure in _____ vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
verse: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
note: Gospel treasure in cheap clay pots — so no one mistakes the glow for the container.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD turned the _____ of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verse: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.
note: Job's turnaround came 'when he prayed for his friends' — the same friends who'd spent chapters lecturing him.
